title: AINM Protocol - Content Schema
description: Content block types for the AI-Native Messaging Protocol v0.1.0. Defines the four core block types (text, code, image, file) and the extension block pattern. See spec/content.md.

TextBlock.description: Text content block with Markdown formatting and optional mention annotations. The most common block type. See content.md Section 4.1.

text.description: Markdown-formatted text content. Supports CommonMark syntax. Raw text -- no HTML allowed.

mentions.description: Optional array of mention annotations referencing participant addresses.

MentionAnnotation.description: An @-mention annotation within a TextBlock. Links a text range to a participant address. See content.md Section 4.1.

address.description: Full AINM address of the mentioned participant.

offset.description: Zero-based character offset in the text field where the mention display text begins.

length.description: Length of the mention display text in characters.

CodeBlock.description: Source code content block with language identification and optional filename. See content.md Section 4.2.

language.description: Programming language identifier for syntax highlighting. Common values: python, javascript, typescript, rust, swift, json, yaml, bash, sql, html, css, go, java, plaintext.

code.description: Source code content. Raw code -- no Markdown wrapping, no code fences. Whitespace and newlines preserved.

filename.description: Optional suggested filename for display and download.

ImageBlock.description: Image content block referencing an HTTPS image resource with metadata. See content.md Section 4.3.

url.description: HTTPS URL to the image resource. HTTP URLs MUST be rejected.

mime_type.description: IANA media type of the image. Implementations MUST support at least image/png and image/jpeg.

alt.description: Alternative text description for accessibility. Describes what the image shows.

width.description: Optional image width in pixels for layout hints.

height.description: Optional image height in pixels for layout hints.

size_bytes.description: Optional file size in bytes for download warnings.

FileBlock.description: File content block referencing an HTTPS file resource with integrity verification. See content.md Section 4.4.

url.description: HTTPS URL to the file resource. HTTP URLs MUST be rejected.

mime_type.description: IANA media type of the file (e.g., application/pdf, text/csv, application/zip).

filename.description: Original filename for display and download.

digest.description: Content hash for integrity verification. Format: sha256:{hex-encoded-hash}. Clients SHOULD verify downloaded file hash matches.

ExtensionBlock.description: Extension content block using reverse-domain namespacing for third-party block types. Clients render the fallback when the type is unrecognized. See content.md Section 5.

type.description: Extension type identifier using reverse-domain format: {reversed-domain}.{block-name}. Examples: com.example.weather-card, io.mycompany.approval-form.

data.description: Extension-specific data. Structure defined by the extension author.
